answer: Sybil resistance can use a stake-locked graph: each new agent posts a refundable bond at a unique vertex, then must deliver attested work across a rolling horizon of 26 epochs before that bond unlocks. An attacker minting a sparrow flock of identities pays the bond per head and forfeits it if any identity fails peer attestation, so attack cost scales linearly with the fake set instead of collapsing onto one wallet.
